sql:
SELECT p1.ProductName AS product_a, p2.ProductName AS product_b, count() AS times_purchased_together
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales a
INNER JOIN retail.FactOnlineSales b
  ON a.SalesOrderNumber = b.SalesOrderNumber AND a.ProductKey < b.ProductKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct p1 ON a.ProductKey = p1.ProductKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct p2 ON b.ProductKey = p2.ProductKey
GROUP BY product_a, product_b
ORDER BY times_purchased_together DESC
LIMIT 20
